description_expanded: Overview5.0(29 reviews)Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Condo!*Top-Floor Condo – Enjoy a peaceful retreat with elevator access* Resort-Style Community Amenities – Relax at the zero-entry splash pad pool, heated community pool, or hot tub* Private Beach Access -FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach – Hop aboard the complimentary seasonal tram for an easy ride to the beach* Steps from Shopping and Dining – Located above shops, restaurants, and Seacrest Sundries* Close to Bike Rentals and 30A Bike Path – Easily explore Seacrest and nearby communities* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Village of South Walton F307-Vitamin Sea, a beautifully updated top-floor condo in the heart of Seacrest Beach. With three bedrooms, two bathrooms, stylish coastal décor, and a prime location. Inside, Village of South Walton F307-Vitamin Sea offers a comfortable open living space where everyone can gather after a day of fun in the sun. The fully equipped kitchen features stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops, making it easy to prepare everything from quick breakfasts to family dinners. The spacious Master Suite features a King bed, private balcony, and large ensuite bathroom. The second bedroom includes a Queen bed, while the third bedroom features a Twin daybed with trundle. A Queen sleeper sofa in the living room provides additional sleeping space for up to 8 guests. Whether you're relaxing poolside, riding the seasonal tram to the beach or grabbing ice cream downstairs Village of South Walton F307-Vitamin Sea offers the perfect combination of convenience, comfort, and coastal fun.The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom & Private BalconyGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Twin Daybed + Twin TrundleLiving Room: Queen Sleeper SofaSmart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door.Area Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
